column1: # Moybyte Zero (ESP32-C3) partition table: 4 MB of in-package flash.
# ONE APP SLOT. The Zero's image carries its own browser console
# bundle alone is more than half of it (the build prints both numbers)
# slots do not fit in 4 MB: this is the Zero "without OTA" (board.toml). The
# factory slot is sized to the image with room to grow -- the build's #168
# guard prints the headroom -- and everything after it is the store.
#   0x3B0000  vfs            320 KB    the store: /moy/carts and the files tree
